name: Kebab Hindi (Syrian Baked Meatballs in Tomato Sauce) with Rice

components.name: Kebab Hindi in Tomato Sauce

ingredients.name: Ground allspice and seven spice blend
Raw ripe tomatoes grated or crushed

steps: Heat oven to 200 C. Mix ground beef with grated onion, chopped garlic, parsley, allspice, salt and pepper. Shape into about 18 short oval kebabs.
Spread kebabs on a shallow oven tray and roast 10-12 minutes to brown. Drain excess rendered fat if necessary.
Meanwhile soften onions and garlic in oil in a saucepan; stir in chopped tomatoes, paste, water and salt and simmer until thickened.
Transfer browned kebabs to a baking dish, cover with the tomato-onion sauce and bake another 20-25 minutes until mince reaches 71 C internally.
Portion three kebabs with tomato sauce and cooked rice into each of six containers.

components.name: Basmati Rice
steps: Rinse and cook uncooked rice with measured water until tender, then cover and rest.
